timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1510 KRW/USD (expected near-term level)

WHY: The news shows conflicting signals—one source predicts the won will *strengthen* (rates falling to 1500–1510), suggesting cheaper dollars ahead, while another warns rates recently hit 17-year highs before authorities intervened. The trend appears volatile with downward pressure expected, but the current level is unclear from these snippets.

TIP: Since you convert a fixed $2,000 monthly, consider splitting purchases across weeks or using limit orders to average the rate rather than timing a single optimal moment in this unstable environment.

articles.title: 고삐 풀린 환율 17년래 최고…실물경제 ‘휘청’
